title: Stream Tournaments on Hash and Earn HashCoins
description: Streamers can earn HashCoins by streaming tournaments on the Hash app: BGMI, Free Fire, Valorant and more. Here is how it works and what you can redeem.

body.text: If you stream games in India, the Hash app gives you a new way to get rewarded for it. Streamers earn HashCoins by streaming tournaments on the app, so the matches you already watch and play can now pay you back in rewards.
Hash runs tournaments across the games Indian players love most:
How streamers earn HashCoins on Hash

items: Download the Hash app and set up your profile.
Find a tournament you want to cover or play in.
Stream the tournament on the app.
Collect HashCoins for streaming, on top of what you earn by playing, booking and referring friends.

body.text: What you can do with HashCoins
HashCoins can be redeemed on passes, offers and gear. Tournament winners also get rewards straight to their Hash wallet, so if you stream and compete, you can earn on both sides.
Tips to grow your tournament stream

items: Stream the same game regularly so viewers know what to expect.
Cover finals and close matches, which draw the biggest audiences.
Share your stream with your squad and community before the match starts.
Play in tournaments too: your own matches make the best content.

body.text: Open the Hash app, pick a tournament and start streaming to earn HashCoins today.
